Walking up to 15km's per day across a variety of terrain to spread bait for invasive species.
Carrying a hand spreader (1-2 kgs including bait) in left hand and turning a crank with right hand to distribute bait from the spreader. Hand spreaders also have a support, which extends on the underside of the forearm from wrist to elbow to distribute weight more evenly.
30 to 60 minutes vehicle travel in work vehicles from the depot to and from a worksite. Driving of work vehicles generally rotates.

Surveillance Duties:

Walking slowly up to 15km's per day across a variety of terrain to search for infestation (nests).
Carrying a light pointer (less than 500gms) in either left or right hand, as preferred, and poking the stick at the ground.
Bending to manually collect suspect ants in a small (<20ml)>30 to 60 minutes vehicle travel in work vehicles from the depot to and from a worksite. Driving of work vehicles generally rotates.
Being exposed to the various outdoor temperature ranges and climatic condition experience in south east Queensland.

• Paperwork

30 to 60 minutes vehicle travel in work vehicles from the depot to and from a worksite. Driving of work vehicles generally rotates.

Bending to manually collect suspect ants in a small (<20ml)>30 to 60 minutes vehicle travel in work vehicles from the depot to and from a worksite. Driving of work vehicles generally rotates.
Being exposed to the various outdoor temperature ranges and climatic condition experience in south east Queensland.

The seasons transfer between Treatment (Warmer Months) and Surveillance (July to September) this is due to the Fire Ants not foraging for food once the ground temperature drops below 18°C.

  • 30 to 60 minutes vehicle travel in work vehicles from the depot to and from a worksite. Driving of work vehicles generally rotates.

Surveillance Duties:

  • Walking slowly up to 15km's per day across a variety of terrain to search for infestation (nests).
  • Carrying a light pointer (less than 500gms) in either left or right hand, as preferred, and poking the stick at the ground.
  • Bending to manually collect suspect ants in a small (<20ml)>30 to 60 minutes vehicle travel in work vehicles from the depot to and from a worksite. Driving of work vehicles generally rotates.
  • Being exposed to the various outdoor temperature ranges and climatic condition experience in south east Queensland.

30 to 60 minutes vehicle travel in work vehicles from the depot to and from a worksite. Driving of work vehicles generally rotates.

Walking slowly up to 15km's per day across a variety of terrain to search for infestation (nests).

Bending to manually collect suspect ants in a small (<20ml)>30 to 60 minutes vehicle travel in work vehicles from the depot to and from a worksite. Driving of work vehicles generally rotates.
Being exposed to the various outdoor temperature ranges and climatic condition experience in south east Queensland.
